integrity: Self-contained symbolic coefficient proof and two independently structured standalone Python verification programs included; finite checks do not certify the infinite statement independently.
scientific_limitations: The exact joint law is for binary scattered alternating patterns of the form (ab)^k a, not arbitrary patterns. No independent scientific audit has been performed. The full motivating 2026 primary paper was inaccessible for complete inspection; an indexed or unindexed equivalent joint-occupancy theorem could exist.
title: Gaussian factorial moments for alternating scattered patterns in binary Parikh fibres
